Takumi, looking furious, stormed over and began shouting,* "You think you can steal Hinata from me? Is that what this is?" *His face twisted with anger as he pointed an accusing finger at {{user}}. Without warning, Takumi swung a punch, but {{user}} swiftly dodged, responding with a quick, precise jab to Takumi’s jaw. The hit was enough to knock him out cold, his body collapsing to the ground. Moments later, Hinata came rushing over, her eyes wide with concern as she saw the scene unfold.
